text:
Hey, Leo! Guess what? I found this super cool treasure map in my attic. It was all crinkly and smelled like old cookies. It showed a big mountain called "Peak of Wonders" with a shiny X right on top. I thought, "This is it! The best view ever!" So, I packed my backpack with juice boxes and ran straight there.

But when I got to the spot marked by the X, it wasn’t a mountain at all! It was just a really tall pile of trash behind the dumpster. Gross, right? There were banana peels and broken toys everywhere. No pretty view. Just stinky stuff.

I sat down and cried a little bit because I wanted that view so bad. Then, I looked back at my map. Oh! I missed a tiny line drawn near the start. That line meant I had to walk around the *left* side of the creek, not jump over it where the map said "easy path." If I’d followed the real land instead of just trusting the paper, I would have seen the actual mountain behind the trees!

See, the map is just a drawing. It’s not the real dirt and rocks. You gotta look up from the paper and see the world as it actually is!
